name: Orient
purpose: Observe the accepted code baseline needed by the active Intent, maintain an Evidence-backed cumulative System Map, and pin the facts used by this Intent.
completion_criteria: Core has produced a deterministic Workspace Profile for every selected Repository root.
A strict System Map Patch has been checked against its base revision, Repository boundaries, source snapshots, Evidence digests, identifier references, and accepted-code-baseline perspective.
The shared CodeKB contains an immutable JSON System Map revision and a validated baseline pointer; no HTML is generated by default.
The Intent Current Context pins the exact System Map revision, source-of-truth path, SHA-256 digest, and selected entity and relation identifiers.
Core records ST-01 completion and advances only through the fixed ST-01 to ST-02 Graph edge.
stop_conditions: ST-00 Bootstrap Receipt, Design Brief, Workspace Profile, Plan, Policy, or Core State is missing, malformed, tampered, or inconsistent.
A Patch uses a stale base revision, unverified Evidence, a path outside its Repository, duplicate or dangling identifiers, planned or production state, or secret-bearing data.
The observed Repository snapshot changed after Core prepared the Orient work request.
Core cannot acquire the Workspace lock or persist canonical JSON, Audit, and State records.
